groups.saying_opens: قلت لأبى بن كعب إن أخاك عبد الله
كان أبو وائل شقيق بن سلمة لا يتكلم
مر رجل على زر بن حبيش وهو يؤذن

notes: Three sayings, each with its own isnad: the Ubayy dialogue on Laylat al-Qadr (saying 1), an anecdote about Abu Wa'il (saying 2), an anecdote about Zarr and the adhan (saying 3); each is stored as its own group (rule 4a)
«وزر بن حبيش يكنى أبا مريم» names the same man just named, in succession: one link (rule 7)
«هو ابن بهدلة» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبو عيسى» is the compiler's comment and is not a link
Ubayy is the last link of saying 1: he answers Zarr's question (rule 6)
